description: Set the pins and shapes drawn on one screenshot in a review, the same marks a person draws in the editor. Pass `pins`, `shapes` or both; each one you pass replaces that item's existing list, and one you leave out is kept. Returns the marked image so you can check the placement. The marks appear on the review page and in every export.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (or the owner's agent token).

item.description: 1-based position of the item in the review, as get_review numbers them.

pins.description: Numbered pins, in order (pin 1 first). Each is {x, y}: fractions of the image's width and height from its top-left corner, 0 to 1. The pin's numbered circle is drawn centred on that point and covers what is under it, so place it beside the thing it marks. An empty list removes every pin.

shapes.description: Arrows, boxes, circles and text labels. Coordinates are fractions 0 to 1 from the top-left. arrow: x1,y1 is the tail and x2,y2 the head. box and circle: opposite corners. text: x1,y1 is the top-left of a single-line label (up to 140 characters) with size s, m or l. Colors: red, orange, yellow, green, pink, black, white. An empty list removes every shape.

name: mark_screenshot
